selected_script.angle: Organizing a cramped bedroom closet spillover with heavy coats and bags using a heavy-duty rolling rack
selected_script.hook: Is your tiny bedroom closet completely overflowing with bulky coats and bags?

0-3s.scene_description: Handheld phone-shot close-up of a messy bedroom floor where several heavy winter coats and handbags are piled up, looking cluttered and disorganized.
0-3s.audio_or_text: Is your tiny bedroom closet completely overflowing with bulky coats and bags?

3-6s.scene_description: Close-up of hands connecting the vertical black metal rods of the rack using thread rolling mounting by twisting and screwing the tubes directly together.
3-6s.audio_or_text: Solve it instantly with this heavy-duty double rod rack.

6-10s.scene_description: Hands hanging thick winter coats neatly onto the high-low staggered double rods of the sturdy matte black metal rack.
6-10s.audio_or_text: Maximized vertical space keeps your coats organized and easy to reach.

10-14s.scene_description: Close-up of a foot pressing down the caster brake levers to lock the 360-degree swivel wheels securely in place on the bedroom floor.
10-14s.audio_or_text: Lock the heavy-duty caster wheels to keep it completely stable.

14-18s.scene_description: Bags and hats neatly hung on the side extension rods, and shoe boxes arranged perfectly on the bottom dual-pipe storage shelf.
14-18s.audio_or_text: Extra side bars and bottom shelves hold everything else.

18-20s.scene_description: A clean, organized bedroom space with the double rod rack holding clothes stably. Light text overlay: 'Get organized today.'
